scientific_integrity: The exact proof uses associated-Legendre Lagrange identities and Wallis comparisons; the finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only complex scalar spherical harmonics on the two-sphere, exactly two adjacent pure degrees and a hemisphere. Does not address other caps, masks or higher-dimensional spheres; priority requires external confirmation.
title: Sharp hemispherical concentration for two consecutive spherical-harmonic degrees
